extraction_notes: 2901.10 = saturated acyclic hydrocarbons (alkanes: methane, ethane, propane, butane, pentane, etc.). Ch.29 Note 1(a).
Ethylene (C2H4) — key olefin monomer for polyethylene/PVC/ethylene oxide.
Propylene (C3H6) — monomer for polypropylene and acrylonitrile.
Butene (C4H8) and isomers — includes 1-butene, 2-butene, isobutene.
Conjugated dienes — butadiene used for SBR/polybutadiene, isoprene for polyisoprene.
Acetylene (C2H2) — simplest alkyne, often dissolved in acetone (DA cylinders). Used in welding and as feedstock for vinyl acetate.
Heptene (C7H14) — higher olefin used in synthesis of plasticizers and surfactants.
Dihydromyrcene — terpene derivative used in fragrance synthesis (citrus notes).
Tetradecene (C14H28) — long-chain alpha-olefin for detergent alkylation, lubricants.
Other unsaturated acyclic hydrocarbons (residual basket under 2901.29).
Cyclohexane (C6H12) — saturated cyclic alkane, precursor to adipic acid/caprolactam for nylon.
Cyclopropyl acetylene — building block in efavirenz (HIV drug) synthesis.
1-MCP — ethylene-blocker used to extend produce shelf life (e.g., apples).
Other cyclanes/cyclenes/cycloterpenes — residual basket under 2902.19.
Benzene (C6H6) — primary aromatic feedstock for styrene, phenol, aniline, cyclohexane.
Toluene (methylbenzene, C7H8) — solvent and precursor to TDI, TNT, benzoic acid.
ortho-Xylene — feedstock for phthalic anhydride (plasticizer manufacture).
meta-Xylene — feedstock for isophthalic acid.
para-Xylene — key feedstock for PTA and PET resins (polyester).
Mixed xylene isomers (o-, m-, p-) — Ch.29 Note 3 isomer mixture. Industrial solvent.
Styrene (vinylbenzene, C8H8) — monomer for polystyrene, ABS, SBR.
Ethylbenzene — dehydrogenated to styrene.
Cumene (isopropylbenzene) — feedstock for the Hock process producing phenol+acetone.
Dipentene (racemic limonene) — terpene solvent/fragrance.
Diphenylmethane — fragrance and chemical intermediate.
Dodecylbenzene (LAB) — precursor to LABSA (sulphonate) for detergents. Description excludes mixed alkylarenes (those go to Ch.38).
Pure naphthalene — fused-ring aromatic; PAH crystallized from coal tar.
Isobutylbenzene — feedstock for ibuprofen (NSAID).
n-Propylbenzene — solvent/intermediate.
Other cyclic hydrocarbons (residual under 2902.90).
Methyl chloride (CH3Cl) — feedstock for silicones and methylating reagent.
Ethyl chloride (C2H5Cl). Description has 'Chloromethane' typo in source; subheading 2903.11 covers chloromethane AND chloroethane.
Methylene chloride (CH2Cl2) — versatile solvent used in pharmaceutical extraction and paint stripping.
Chloroform (CHCl3) — laboratory solvent and feedstock for HCFC-22.
CCl4 — Montreal Protocol controlled ODS; restricted to feedstock use.
EDC (C2H4Cl2) — feedstock for vinyl chloride monomer (VCM) and PVC.
Tetrachloroethane (C2H2Cl4) — solvent/precursor to trichloroethylene.
Methyl chloroform — Montreal Protocol ODS.
Other trichloroethane isomers (e.g., 1,1,2-trichloroethane).
Binary mixture of two distinct halogenated compounds (EDC + CCl4) — not a separate chemically-defined compound, not an isomer mixture per Ch.29 N.3. Mapped to 'other'. Historic grain fumigant.
Other saturated chlorinated acyclic hydrocarbons.
VCM (C2H3Cl) — monomer for PVC.
TCE — industrial metal degreasing solvent.
PERC — dominant dry-cleaning solvent.
Other unsaturated chlorinated acyclic hydrocarbons (basket).
DD mixture (binary mixture of dichloropropene + dichloropropane) — soil fumigant for nematode control. Not a single compound, not pure isomer mixture.
Residual other under 2903.29.
HFC-23 (CHF3) — high-GWP greenhouse gas; HCFC-22 byproduct.
HFC-32 (CH2F2) — common AC refrigerant.
HFC-41, HFC-152, HFC-152a — refrigerants and propellants.
HFC-125, HFC-143a, HFC-143 — refrigerants (often blended in R-410A, R-404A).
HFC-134a — globally dominant automotive AC refrigerant.
HFC-227ea, HFC-236cb, HFC-236ea, HFC-236fa — fire suppressants and refrigerants.
HFC-245fa — primary polyurethane foam blowing agent.
HFC-365mfc and HFC-43-10mee — foam blowing and precision cleaning solvents.
Other saturated fluorinated derivatives of acyclic hydrocarbons (residual).
HFO-1234yf (current auto AC refrigerant), HFO-1234ze, HFO-1336mzz — low-GWP refrigerants.
PFIB — Chemical Weapons Convention Schedule 2 toxic chemical.
Other unsaturated fluorinated acyclic derivatives.
Methyl bromide — Montreal Protocol ODS, restricted to QPS use.
EDB — historic gasoline additive (lead scavenger); now restricted.
Other brominated/iodinated acyclic hydrocarbons (residual).
HCFC-22 (CHClF2) — refrigerant being phased out under Montreal Protocol; precursor to TFE/PTFE.
HCFC-123 — centrifugal chiller refrigerant; ODS.
HCFC-141b — foam blowing agent, phased out under Montreal Protocol.
HCFC-142b — refrigerant and blowing agent.
HCFC-225 isomers (225ca, 225cb) — precision cleaning solvent.
Halon-1211 — fire suppressant; production banned under Montreal Protocol.
Halon-1301 — fire suppressant; ODS, banned for new production.
Halon-2402 — fire suppressant; ODS.
CFC-13 — Montreal Protocol Annex A; production phased out.
CFC-12 (R-12) — historic refrigerant; Montreal Protocol banned.
CFC-11 — historic blowing agent; Montreal Protocol banned.
CFC-115 — historic refrigerant component (R-502); ODS.
CFC-114 — historic refrigerant.
CFC-113 — historic electronics cleaning solvent; ODS.
CFC-112 — solvent; ODS.
CFC-111 — ODS.
Chloroheptafluoropropane — perhalogenated CFC propane; ODS.
Dichlorohexafluoropropane — perhalogenated propane CFC; ODS.
Trichloropentafluoropropane — perhalogenated propane CFC; ODS.
Tetrachlorotetrafluoropropane — perhalogenated propane CFC; ODS.
Pentachlorotrifluoropropane — perhalogenated propane CFC; ODS.
Hexachlorodifluoropropane — perhalogenated propane CFC; ODS.
Heptachlorofluoropropane — perhalogenated propane CFC; ODS.
Other perhalogenated CFC derivatives.
Other perhalogenated derivatives (multiple-halogen).
HCFC-124 — refrigerant.
Other methane/ethane/propane derivatives halogenated only with F and Cl.
Derivatives of methane/ethane/propane halogenated only with F and Br.
Other halogenated acyclic hydrocarbons with two or more different halogens.
HCH and lindane — Stockholm Convention POP; historic insecticide.
Stockholm POPs — banned insecticides.
Mirex — Stockholm POP; historic pesticide and flame retardant.
HBCD — Stockholm POP; flame retardant for polystyrene.
Other halogenated cyclanic/cyclenic/cycloterpenic derivatives.
Monochlorobenzene — solvent/intermediate for nitrochlorobenzenes.
ortho-Dichlorobenzene — solvent/intermediate.
para-Dichlorobenzene — mothballs / urinal deodorant.
HCB — Stockholm POP; banned fungicide.
DDT Technical 75 WDP — Stockholm POP with India-specific exemption for IRS malaria control.
Other DDT formulations — POP.
Pentachlorobenzene — Stockholm POP.
Hexabromobiphenyls — Stockholm POP brominated flame retardant.
Benzal chloride (alpha,alpha-dichlorotoluene) — precursor to benzaldehyde.
Benzotrichloride (alpha,alpha,alpha-trichlorotoluene) — precursor to benzoyl chloride.
Benzyl chloride (alpha-chlorotoluene) — versatile alkylating agent.
para-Chlorotoluene (4-chloromethylbenzene per description) — dye/pesticide intermediate.
Chlorinated naphthalenes — historic dielectric fluid/wood preservative.

Chlorofluoroaniline. NOTE: despite the aniline (amine) name, this code sits in 2903.99 (halogenated hydrocarbons) per Indian schedule; in standard HS the amine functional group would push it to Ch.29.21, but India retains this code at 2903.99.70.
Other halogenated aromatic derivatives (residual basket).
Benzenesulphonic acid — acid catalyst and dye intermediate.
Armstrong's acid (1,5-NDSA) — dye intermediate.
Naphthalenesulphonic acid — dye intermediate and concrete superplasticizer precursor.
Other sulphonated/nitrosulphonated derivatives.
Nitrobenzene (C6H5NO2) — primary feedstock for aniline.
meta-Dinitrobenzene — dye intermediate.
meta-Nitrotoluene — dye intermediate.
ortho-Nitrotoluene — dye intermediate.
para-Nitrotoluene — dye intermediate and p-toluidine precursor.
DNT — feedstock for toluene diisocyanate (TDI) and explosives.
Other nitrated derivatives.
PFOS — Stockholm POP; historic surfactant in firefighting foam.
Ammonium PFOS salt — POP.
Lithium PFOS salt — POP.
Potassium PFOS salt — POP.
Other PFOS salts — POP.
POSF — PFOS precursor; POP.
Chloropicrin — soil fumigant; war gas precursor.
2,5-Dichloronitrobenzene — dye intermediate.
DNCB — dye intermediate; also a contact allergen used in immunology.
meta-Nitrochlorobenzene — dye intermediate.
ortho-Nitrochlorobenzene — dye intermediate.
para-Nitrochlorobenzene — pNCB; dye/drug intermediate.
2-Nitrochlorotoluene — dye intermediate.
Sodium m-nitrochlorobenzene sulphonate — multi-functionalized aromatic salt (dye intermediate).
Other sulphonated/nitrated/nitrosated derivatives (residual).
Methanol (CH3OH) — feedstock for formaldehyde, MTBE, biodiesel transesterification.
n-Propanol — solvent for resins/cellulose esters.
IPA — solvent, hand sanitizer base, pharmaceutical excipient.
n-Butanol — solvent and feedstock for butyl acrylate, butyl acetate.
Ethambutol — anti-TB drug.
Salbutamol sulphate (albuterol) — bronchodilator for asthma/COPD.
Amino butanol — ethambutol intermediate (note: amino+alcohol functionality, sits in 2905.14 sub-line under Indian schedule).
Other butanols (isobutanol, sec-butanol, t-butanol).
Dimethyl octanol (tetrahydrogeraniol) — fragrance.
2-EH — feedstock for DOP/DEHP plasticizer.
Other octanols (residual).
C12/C16/C18 fatty alcohols — surfactant and cosmetic ingredients (cetostearyl).
Pinacolyl alcohol — CWC Schedule 2 precursor (soman nerve agent precursor).
Triacontanol (C30 fatty alcohol) — plant growth regulator.
Other saturated monohydric alcohols.
Citronellol — rose-like fragrance terpene alcohol.
Geraniol — rose-like fragrance terpene alcohol.
Linalool — floral fragrance terpene alcohol.
Rhodinol — rose-like fragrance terpene alcohol.
Dihydromyrcenol — fresh citrus fragrance alcohol.
Other acyclic terpene alcohols.
Other unsaturated monohydric alcohols.
MEG — polyester (PET) feedstock and antifreeze.
Propylene glycol — solvent, humectant, food/pharma additive.

Butylene glycol isomers (1,4/1,3/2,3). 1,4-BD feedstock for THF/PBT. NOTE: code groups 3 isomers; not a true Ch.29 N.3 isomer mixture (those are isomers of one substance not separately codified) — kept as separate_organic_compound per validation-set convention for hetero-compound groupings.
Hexylene glycol (2-methyl-2,4-pentanediol) — cosmetic solvent.
Other diols.
TMP — triol for alkyd resins and polyurethanes.
Dipentaerythritol — hexol for alkyd resins.
Other pentaerythritols. Parent 2905.42 covers pentaerythritol family.
Mannitol (hexitol) — sugar alcohol; pharma diluent and osmotic diuretic.
Sorbitol — sweetener, humectant, vitamin C precursor.
Glycerol — biodiesel byproduct; cosmetic/pharma humectant. Note: crude glycerol from saponification is Ch.15.20, this is the pure chemical.
Other polyhydric alcohols.
Ethchlorvynol — historic sedative-hypnotic.
Other halogenated/sulphonated/nitrated derivatives of acyclic alcohols.
Natural menthol — extracted from peppermint oil. India is largest producer.
Synthetic menthol.
Cyclohexanol — feedstock for adipic acid (nylon 66).
Cholesterol — sterol; pharma intermediate (steroid synthesis), cosmetic ingredient.
Other sterols and inositols (subheading 2906.13).
Borneol — bicyclic terpene alcohol; camphor precursor.
Other cyclanic/cyclenic/cycloterpenic alcohols.
Benzyl alcohol — pharma preservative/solvent, fragrance.
Cinnamyl alcohol — hyacinth/cinnamon fragrance.
2-Phenylethanol — rose fragrance.
Dicofol — Stockholm POP; acaricide.
Other aromatic alcohols.
Pure phenol (C6H5OH) — feedstock for bisphenol A, phenolic resins, caprolactam.
Other phenol grades (technical, etc.).
para-Cresol — antioxidant precursor (BHT).
Cresylic acid — Ch.29 Note 3 isomer mixture of cresols+xylenols+phenols.
Other cresols (o-, m-, mixtures).
Octylphenol/nonylphenol — surfactant precursors (NPE/OPE ethoxylates).
alpha-Naphthol — feedstock for carbaryl insecticide.
beta-Naphthol — azo dye coupling component.
Other naphthols/salts.
ortho-Phenylphenol — fungicide/preservative.
para-Phenylphenol — phenolic resin component.
Thymol — from thyme oil; antiseptic/mouthwash.
PTBP — adhesive/resin precursor.
Other alkylphenols (generic).
Other monophenols.
Resorcinol (1,3-dihydroxybenzene) — tire-cord adhesive (RFL), pharma.
Hydroquinone (1,4-dihydroxybenzene) — antioxidant, photo developer, depigmenter.
BPA — feedstock for polycarbonate (Lexan) and epoxy resins.
1,5-DHN — azo dye intermediate.
THPE — multifunctional phenol for high-perf epoxies.
TBHQ (E319) — food antioxidant.
Acequinocyl (acaricide) + metamifop (herbicide) — agrochemical AIs sharing this code.
Other polyphenols/phenol-alcohols.
PCP — Stockholm POP; wood preservative.
Other halogen-only-substituted phenol derivatives (e.g., chlorophenols).
Dinoseb — restricted herbicide (PIC convention).
DNOC — restricted pesticide (PIC).
para-Nitrophenol — paracetamol and parathion intermediate.
Musk xylol — nitromusk fragrance (largely phased out due to bioaccumulation).
Dinocap (fungicide), meptyldinocap (acaricide), Na-PNP — agrochemicals.
Other phenol derivatives (residual).
Diethyl ether — classic lab solvent and historic anesthetic.
TAME — gasoline oxygenate.
MTBE — dominant gasoline oxygenate (banned in some US states).
Other acyclic ethers.
Cyclanic/cyclenic/cycloterpenic ethers and derivatives.
Substituted anisole — dye intermediate.
ortho-Nitroanisole — dye intermediate.
Ethoxysulfuron (rice herbicide) and famoxadone (fungicide).
Other anisole derivatives.
Diphenyl ether — heat transfer fluid (Dowtherm A), perfumery (geranium note).
Musk ambrette — nitromusk; largely phased out.
DecaBDE — Stockholm POP; brominated flame retardant.
Ether-linked agrochemicals: ethofenprox (insecticide), fomesafen/oxyfluorfen (herbicides).
Other aromatic ethers (residual).
DEG — solvent and feedstock for morpholine/PEG.
Butyl cellosolve and butyl carbitol — coalescent solvents.
Other monoalkyl ethers of EG/DEG (methyl, ethyl cellosolve, etc.).
Phenoxyethanol — cosmetic preservative.
Pyriproxyfen intermediate.
MPBA — pyrethroid (cypermethrin, permethrin) intermediate.
Other ether-alcohols.
Guaiacol — vanillin synthesis intermediate; expectorant.
Isoeugenol — clove-like fragrance.
Potassium guaiacol sulphonate — pharmaceutical expectorant.
MEHQ — polymerization inhibitor for acrylates.
BHA (E320) — food antioxidant.
Other ether-phenols.
MCPA amine salt — phenoxy herbicide. NOTE: subheading 2909.60 is for alcohol/ether/ketone peroxides, but Indian schedule uses 2909.60.10 for this MCPA salt — sub-classification anomaly.
Other alcohol/ether/ketone peroxides (e.g., MEKP).
Ethylene oxide (C2H4O) — three-membered ring epoxide; precursor to ethylene glycol/PET, also medical/spice sterilant.
Propylene oxide — feedstock for polyether polyols (PU foam) and propylene glycol.
Epichlorohydrin — key monomer for bisphenol-A epoxy resins; also synthetic glycerol route.
Dieldrin — cyclodiene organochlorine insecticide; Stockholm Convention POP; banned in most jurisdictions.
Endrin — stereoisomer of dieldrin; Stockholm POP; banned organochlorine insecticide.
Epoxiconazole — triazole DMI fungicide for cereals; classified here as the epoxide ring is the functional moiety.
Other epoxides, epoxyalcohols/phenols/ethers with three-membered ring (residual basket under 2910).
Acetals/hemiacetals (R-CH(OR')2 / R-CH(OH)(OR')) — protected aldehyde/ketone forms; flavour/fragrance and synthesis intermediates.
Other acetals/hemiacetals incl. halogenated/sulphonated/nitrated derivatives (residual basket under 2911).
Formaldehyde (HCHO) — simplest aldehyde; gas or 37% aqueous formalin; resin and disinfectant feedstock.
Acetaldehyde (CH3CHO) — C2 aldehyde; Wacker process; precursor to acetic acid and ethyl acetate.
Crotonaldehyde (CH3-CH=CH-CHO) — alpha,beta-unsaturated; sorbic acid precursor and denaturant.
Heptanal (n-heptaldehyde, C7) — fatty-green fragrance aldehyde; pyrolysis product of castor oil.
Glyoxal (OHC-CHO) — simplest dialdehyde; cellulose crosslinker for wrinkle-resistant cotton.
Other acyclic aldehydes without other oxygen function (residual basket under 2912.19).
Benzaldehyde (C6H5CHO) — bitter almond aroma; simplest aromatic aldehyde.
Cinnamaldehyde (PhCH=CH-CHO) — primary cinnamon flavour molecule.
Phenylacetaldehyde (PhCH2CHO) — hyacinth/honey note; perfumery.
Hexyl cinnamaldehyde (HCA) — high-volume jasmine-floral perfumery aldehyde.
Other cyclic aldehydes without other oxygen function (residual basket under 2912.29).
Vanillin — primary vanilla flavour molecule; both phenol-OH and methoxy-OEt + aldehyde → multi-oxygen function aromatic aldehyde.
Ethylvanillin — ethyl analogue of vanillin, ~3x stronger vanilla flavour; ethoxy replaces vanillin's methoxy.
Anisaldehyde — hawthorn/anise fragrance; antihistamine intermediate.
Heliotropin (piperonyl aldehyde / piperonal) — sweet floral-vanilla scent; methylenedioxy ring.
Thiacetazone — thiosemicarbazone TB drug; aldehyde with other oxygen/N function; second-line antimycobacterial.
3,4,5-Trimethoxybenzaldehyde — key trimethoprim intermediate.
Other aldehyde-alcohols (compounds with both -CHO and -OH) under 2912.49.
Other aldehyde-ethers/aldehyde-phenols and aldehydes with other oxygen function (residual basket under 2912.49).
Metaldehyde — cyclic tetramer of acetaldehyde; slug/snail pellets and solid fuel tablets.
Other cyclic polymers of aldehydes (e.g., paraldehyde, trioxane) under 2912.50 residual basket.
Paraformaldehyde — solid linear polymer of formaldehyde (8-100 HCHO units); convenient HCHO source.
ortho-Chlorobenzaldehyde — halogenated derivative of benzaldehyde (2913); dye/pharma intermediate.
Other halogenated/sulphonated/nitrated/nitrosated derivatives of products of heading 2912 (residual basket under 2913).
Acetone — simplest acyclic ketone; major solvent and cumene-process byproduct alongside phenol.
MEK (butan-2-one) — strong polar solvent for nitrocellulose, vinyl coatings, adhesives.
MIBK — branched C6 ketone; paint/lacquer solvent and 6PPD antiozonant precursor.
Isophorone — cyclohexenone-class solvent; classified here under acyclic ketones per ITC line wording (despite the ring), reflecting Indian schedule placement.
Other acyclic ketones without other oxygen function (residual basket under 2914.19).
Cyclohexanone + methylcyclohexanones — KA oil; precursor to adipic acid and caprolactam (nylon).
beta-Ionone — violet-scented C13 terpenoid; primary commercial vitamin A synthesis starting material.
Pseudoionone — open-chain dienone precursor; cyclized to alpha/beta-ionones.
Other ionones and methylionones (alpha-ionone, methylionone variants) under 2914.23 basket.
L-Carvone — spearmint odour enantiomer of carvone (D-carvone = caraway).
Synthetic camphor (from alpha-pinene via camphene) — Indian schedule distinguishes synthetic vs natural at the 8-digit level; major religious-use market in India.
Pentyl-2-cyclopenten-1-one (jasmone-type) — synthetic jasmine perfumery aroma.
Cyclohexanedione (1,3- or 1,4-) — diketone scaffold for herbicide and pharma synthesis.
Iso E Super (octahydrotetramethylacetonaphthone) — iconic woody-amber fragrance ingredient.
Pyridaben — pyridazinone acaricide; mitochondrial complex I inhibitor.
Other cyclanic/cyclenic/cycloterpenic ketones without other oxygen function (residual basket under 2914.29).
P2P (phenylacetone) — Table I 1988 UN Convention precursor for amphetamine/methamphetamine; tightly controlled.
Acetophenone (PhCOCH3) — simplest aromatic ketone; orange-blossom note and photoinitiator scaffold.
Benzanthrone — anthraquinone-fused PAH ketone; precursor to vat dyes (e.g., Caledon Jade Green).
Benzophenone (Ph2CO) — UV photoinitiator/UV blocker and fragrance fixative.
Violanthrone (dibenzanthrone) — blue vat dye (CI Vat Blue 20); benzanthrone dimer.
Aromatic-ketone agrochemicals: mesotrione (HPPD herbicide for corn) and metrafenone (powdery mildew fungicide).
Other aromatic ketones without other oxygen function (residual basket under 2914.39).
Ketone-alcohols and ketone-aldehydes (e.g., 4-hydroxy-4-methylpentan-2-one diacetone alcohol, acetol) under 2914.40.
Ketone-phenols and ketones with other oxygen function (e.g., hydroxyacetophenones, p-hydroxyacetophenone) under 2914.50.
Anthraquinone — core scaffold for anthraquinone vat/disperse dyes; also kraft pulping catalyst.
Coenzyme Q10 (ubidecarenone) — mitochondrial benzoquinone; cardiac/antioxidant supplement.
Quinizarin (1,4-dihydroxyanthraquinone) — disperse-blue and acid-dye precursor.
Methylanthraquinone — methyl-substituted anthraquinone; dye intermediate (e.g., 2-methylAQ used in H2O2 anthraquinone process).
Spinosad/spinetoram — fermentation-derived spinosyn macrolides with quinone-like ring system; nicotinic acetylcholine receptor agonists.
Other quinones (e.g., benzoquinone, naphthoquinone derivatives) under 2914.69 residual basket.
Chlordecone (Kepone) — perchlorinated cage ketone; Stockholm POP; banned insecticide.
1-Chloroanthraquinone — alpha-halogenated anthraquinone; alpha-amino-AQ dye intermediate.
Musk ketone — classic nitro-musk fragrance (4'-tert-butyl-2',6'-dimethyl-3',5'-dinitroacetophenone).
Trifluoromethylacetophenone — CF3-bearing aromatic ketone; building block for fluoxetine-class drugs and agrochemicals.
Chloro-4-(4-chlorophenoxy)acetophenone — chloroaryl-ether-ketone azole antifungal intermediate.
Dichloroacetophenone — including chloroacetophenone (CN tear gas) and 2,2'-dichloroacetophenone pharma intermediate.
Tembotrione — triketone HPPD inhibitor; post-emergence corn herbicide.
Other halogenated, sulphonated, nitrated or nitrosated derivatives of products of 2914 (residual basket under 2914.79).
Formic acid (HCOOH) — simplest carboxylic acid; major leather/silage/rubber-coagulation use in India.
Sodium formate — sodium salt of formic acid; environmentally-friendlier runway de-icer than urea/chloride.
Other formate salts (e.g., potassium, calcium, ammonium formate) under 2915.12 basket.
Esters of formic acid (e.g., methyl formate, ethyl formate, geranyl formate) — solvents and fragrance esters.
Acetic acid (CH3COOH) — glacial; backbone of VAM, acetic anhydride, PTA chains.
Acetic anhydride — major acetylating agent; Table I 1988 UN precursor (heroin diversion); India NCB-monitored.
Calcium acetate — food preservative E263 and phosphate binder in dialysis patients.
Magnesium acetate — textile mordant/dye carrier and deodorizer.
Manganese acetate — oxidation catalyst (PTA process, p-xylene oxidation) and paint-drier.
Other acetate salts (e.g., sodium, potassium, cobalt, copper acetate) under 2915.29 basket.
Ethyl acetate — high-volume coatings/printing-ink solvent; food-contact (coffee decaffeination).
Vinyl acetate monomer (VAM) — feedstock for PVA emulsions, EVAc copolymer, PVOH.
n-Butyl acetate — slower-evaporating coatings/lacquer solvent; banana-like odour.
Dinoseb acetate — acetate ester of dinoseb dinitrophenol herbicide; Rotterdam PIC-listed.
Benzyl acetate — characteristic jasmine top-note; main ester in jasmine absolute.
Bornyl + isobornyl acetate — bicyclic terpene acetates with woody-pine note; household fragrances.
Linalyl acetate — primary aroma constituent of lavender and bergamot oils.
Methyl acetate — fast-evaporating exempt-VOC solvent; nail-polish remover alternative to acetone.
Phenyl propyl acetate — sweet floral-balsamic fragrance ester; perfumery.
Terpinyl acetate — floral-bergamot terpene ester; cardamom-oil constituent.
ortho-tert-Butylcyclohexyl acetate — woody-fruity floral ester (Verdox isomer).
para-tert-Butylcyclohexyl acetate — Vertenex/Oryclone-type woody-fruity floral fragrance ester.
Methylcyclohexyl acetate — mid-volatility floral-woody fragrance and lacquer solvent.
Cellosolve acetate (EGMEA) — glycol-ether-acetate coating solvent; reproductive toxicity concern.
Other acetic acid esters (residual basket under 2915.39).
Monochloroacetic acid (MCA), its salts and esters — feedstock for CMC, glyphosate, ibuprofen.
Dichloroacetic acid (DCA), its salts and esters — investigational lactic-acidosis drug and topical cauterant.
Trichloroacetic acid (TCA), its salts and esters — protein-precipitating reagent and chemical-peel agent.
Propionic acid, its salts (Ca/Na/K propionate E280-283) and esters — mold inhibitor in bread and animal feed.
Butanoic (butyric) acid, its salts and esters — rancid-butter odour; CAB cellulose plastic and butyrate esters for flavour.
